[SYSTEM] The Partnership on AI (PAI) focuses on responsible sourcing through its workstream on Responsible Sourcing Across the Data Supply Line, which aims to improve working conditions, fair pay, and well-being for global data enrichment and annotation professionals. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHrOzAVhLF-HqgyDY2ibtzMNR6ewH3hO-GJaMf6TQcxxCokUAEnG5rOTKamVs1FUFLMD2zRY-hsMH0zOEim1Hhq4fw3A7YqViOWDQqJ3WkrI9LlpC9qGzki6dLesQYaJD7dxbg6Nzm1C7OX0UN0pFB9Eitq), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEB6zswFcijssYIixxqPeJWFKr06zM6Te2Yt-2Z8S9-QcFLUHLrBEuNgxhlS6isT00BEgbv_OLO2N4zVHKabTyTw-lDrVD2rSLWoHgFbjYxqIOOLh_Qn7xbqmXPt5Ri9yPw-UP_bAaxy4dzPknOu0YbNvMq19YeIkTBo6zs8fbN2xyMp4DU)]
Key Frameworks and Resources

* Responsible Sourcing of Data Enrichment Services: A foundational white paper published by PAI that examines how procurement choices impact data workers and outlines industry practices to build an ethical supply chain. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHrOzAVND9eFZCGixAz3bZoO8wN8T9qrb8BmKoRzy6IulvThWyTeBETsd2J4trGMIMtbg7zYS6Y9Ja767PdiEnxPaiDR3LxVVdHsUQEgYaInf2y_RBzgujcY0fGZabmBhU5kr4hA_KEYCr1cRv9zBsjhvR2DsT46Q), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHrOzAVFmcQ-XobG4Ddo1Uwj9nuP6v50MoC0NJZZFNYIvJmN87T4gwUvKcPdV4wKToiekCSVzQDwDw_d3pz-0lYs3A7VflUuRtetPoetJTTR9bDy_PTeCPMQIsOAxV01gMmENlmct6cACPKgIVF)]
* Vendor Engagement Guidance: Practical tools to help AI developers have more accountable conversations with downstream vendors regarding worker treatment and contract terms. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEB6zswFcijssYIixxqPeJWFKr06zM6Te2Yt-2Z8S9-QcFLUHLrBEuNgxhlS6isT00BEgbv_OLO2N4zVHKabTyTw-lDrVD2rSLWoHgFbjYxqIOOLh_Qn7xbqmXPt5Ri9yPw-UP_bAaxy4dzPknOu0YbNvMq19YeIkTBo6zs8fbN2xyMp4DU)]
* Transparency Template: A standard outlining what companies should actively monitor and publicly report about their data enrichment operations. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEB6zswFcijssYIixxqPeJWFKr06zM6Te2Yt-2Z8S9-QcFLUHLrBEuNgxhlS6isT00BEgbv_OLO2N4zVHKabTyTw-lDrVD2rSLWoHgFbjYxqIOOLh_Qn7xbqmXPt5Ri9yPw-UP_bAaxy4dzPknOu0YbNvMq19YeIkTBo6zs8fbN2xyMp4DU)]
* Data Enrichment Sourcing Guidelines & Checklists: Shareable resources—including the Good Instructions Checklist and vendor comparison templates—designed to operationalize worker-centric standards. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESpQEB6zswFcmZkTtYbzCA9zH2osAMKR_j-Iiu7d_b9Ld_CkffQco1ST2-pKSq3yfrGCDoha4HKXRnFsbr3cXXh8gKD5z6nyCEgS_rnLA76ossU_DbJBHd2Z9ihpoQ3E8L6ONaZyCdO9jR-qwBXba1PTsjr_q6APTT8ZmH1jKDdTU8XiKBr7cbBuRllyOjRFw1mmq55pGQKaJoofkeIns9OxzvcCt1VK4)]

Real-World Implementation

* DeepMind Collaboration: PAI partnered with Google DeepMind to test and put these responsible sourcing recommendations into operational practice, sharing lessons learned to help other AI organizations raise standards across the industry. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHrOzAVZ9hzdvGoFuVTV7gTFhG86AR5uDnJY3wi5ilH7QV-n2R6X5vrF8RH-diU5rt4dkK6Mzo28ei88Z-zL_u0CXLpckNCfr7hchlZONkKRgnye3L1rh8dC04pymqKlQnxaHpCbolMyrkd4gwwfMkmbU_9ssJQaw), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVjwkAM8M4WzQceYJFLyQmDpVCSyxnUdjvcvXXHA97v_BWieBiHfslPU-1kbHVTFE5TyPZNlvbxD7iznnDk89tONIy_aEaNJaSCHgPG24Ich5w5V7Blcng2dU9EDkrFQ)]

transcript_class: CAPTURE-TIME VERBATIM RECORD — paste of the Overview expanded, with its source cards
d: PARTNERSHIP ON AI RESPONSIBLE SOURCING, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'The Partnership on AI (PAI) focuses on responsible sourcing through its workstream on Responsible Sourcing Across the Data Supply Line, which aims to improve working conditions, fair pay, and well-being for global data enrichment and annotation professionals.' Four resources (the white paper, vendor engagement guidance, the transparency template, the guidelines and checklists) and the DeepMind collaboration. Seven cards, five of them PAI's own.
reading: The innocent reading first. The Overview names the workstream by its own title, lists its resources and the one implementation, from PAI's pages.
findings: THE WORKSTREAM HELD. Its title, its aim, its resources and the DeepMind collaboration are the record's; the vendor engagement guidance and transparency template were introduced in August 2024 and finalized in PAI's post of 29 April 2026 (card 3), which the composition follows. Checked 2026-10-29 against the Labor Vector census record of the same day and the sources it saved.

THE GUIDELINES' CONTENT ABSENT. The record carries the first guideline: pay all data enrichment workers above the local living wage, including time spent reading instructions and in training. The composition names 'fair pay' as an aim and gives no guideline.

THE LIMIT ABSENT. The guidelines were tested at one AI developer, and the DeepMind case study is DeepMind's account with PAI; the composition's 'sharing lessons learned to help other AI organizations raise standards' gives the test as a demonstration.

WHAT THE RECORD IS NOT. The record keeps the resource apart from a dataset or survey of workers and from a rating of vendors. The composition's template sentence is card 3's nearly word for word ('outlines what companies should be monitoring and publicly reporting'), with its force raised to 'A standard'.
WORDS FROM OTHER HANDS. 'ethical supply chain' is the vendor Sama's phrase for its own effort (card 5), given as what the white paper outlines.
analysis: Practitioner guidance is composed as guidance, at the grain of its own index page. The composition carries who the guidance addresses and leaves out what it asks them to pay, and the single-developer basis of its implementation.
per_note: PAI and Google DeepMind named; no person; no identifier; PAI's own pages cited.

read.notes: Claim boundary present: recommendations and practitioner resources (white paper, guidelines, checklist, templates, vendor guidance) and their testing with DeepMind ('to test and put these responsible sourcing recommendations into operational practice'), carried as guidance; the 'Transparency Template' as 'A standard outlining what companies should actively monitor and publicly report' goes beyond the saved sources (the census lists the template unread) and is not judged. Purpose present: the workstream's aim to improve working conditions and well-being of data enrichment workers. Commitments absent: none of the five guidelines' obligations (the living wage counting instruction and training time, payment for completed work, pilots, verified instructions, contestable rejections) is carried; 'worker-centric standards' names them without content. Lineage present: the white paper bound as the foundation ('foundational'); DeepMind appears as the implementing partner, consistent with the record. Institution absent: the AI, Labor, and the Economy programme is not named. Deposit chain absent: the resources are listed as components, not as a dated sequence.
